question: Are attention weights close to uniform in the trained models?
scope: Post-hoc descriptive training-input audit; no fits, new selection or later outcomes
sample: 32 evenly spaced existing training contexts per mouse
metrics: mean row entropy divided by log(number of allowed keys), excluding singleton causal rows
mean total variation from uniform over allowed keys
limits: Attention weights are not causal explanations; this describes variation, not usefulness
